biological_interpretation: Core late-endosome trafficking and TSC loss converge on a neuronal lysosomal-sterol stress state that is not triggered by loss of a terminal lysosomal protease. / Sialin loss generates a cell-state-restricted neuronal stress pattern and should not be treated as a broad neuronal transcriptome defect in this assay. / Sialin/SLC17A5 loss may impinge on a Rab7-HOPS lysosomal branch tied to mTOR/TFEB signaling, rather than generating a uniform lysosomal-storage or all-VPS trafficking RNA state.
caveats: The target transcript never passed FDR<0.05 and weak forebrain responses coincide with weak target knockdown, so this is not proof that forebrain cells buffer loss of VPS41 protein.
No lysosomal pH, sialic-acid storage, or protein-level measurements were available, so compensation is inferred from transcript identity and direction.
Only two cell types had Rab7 transcript FDR<0.05; transcriptomic response is not a direct flux assay.
The module is inferred from RNA differential expression; protein phosphorylation, S6K/S6 phosphorylation, SREBP cleavage, and lysosomal flux were not measured.
Target-transcript knockdown itself was weak by FDR, and the assay reports RNA output rather than mTORC1 protein activity.
This is a transcriptomic cross-perturbation contrast; TSC and Rab7 act upstream of lysosomal physiology and are not catalytic paralogs of Ctsb.
The target transcript itself was not FDR-significantly depleted in any cell type, and some low-count classes have limited power.
The neighbor analysis used only the top 200 Slc17a5-scoring genes per cell type and measures transcriptomic correlation, not physical interaction or pathway epistasis.
All correlations were modest in absolute value; canonical HOPS subunits other than Vps41 were not in the perturbation library.

Exact log2 fold changes, scores, p-values, and FDRs in exact_de_rows were re-read from the Wilcoxon Parquet; the graph and cluster summaries were used only to nominate the target/readout combinations.
exact_observed_result: Vps41, Slc17a5, Rab7, Tsc1, and Tsc2 perturbations up-regulated lysosomal genes such as Mcoln1, Atp6v0b, Atp6v1b2, Lamp2, Gba, Dpp7, Gm2a and sterol genes including Insig1, Srebf2, Dhcr24, Msmo1, Fdps, and Cyp51 in selected TH/MB/P-MY neurons, while Ctsb remained buffered. / Slc17a5 perturbation produced FDR-resolved responses only in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA, while most tested cell types were buffered or underpowered despite nominal Slc17a5 lowering. / Slc17a5 restricted-signature neighbors preferentially implicated Vps41, Rab7, Tsc1/Tsc2, and V-ATPase perturbations, while Vps41 was closest to Rab7 and Tsc1/Tsc2-Dctn1/Dync1h1/Slc17a5 neighbors and only weakly related to retromer and GARP VPS-family perturbations. Parquet-verified leading rows: Ctsb->Ctsb in 155 MB Glut log2FC -2.41, FDR 3.08e-81; Ctsb->Ctsb in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut log2FC -1.48, FDR 8.54e-43; Ctsb->Ctsb in 191 MB P MY GABA log2FC -2.2, FDR 6.06e-31; Tsc1->Cpeb1 in 155 MB Glut log2FC 1.16, FDR 2.44e-28; Tsc1->Stmn4 in 155 MB Glut log2FC 1.29, FDR 2.90e-28; Tsc1->Atp6v0b in 155 MB Glut log2FC 0.526, FDR 1.40e-21.

prior_expectation.summary: References were retained only when they were linked to one of the resolved source findings.

finding_summaries.direction: Vps41 down; downstream response strongest in midbrain/hindbrain cell classes
finding_summaries.summary: Robust Vps41 transcript depletion and downstream transcriptional response were concentrated in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA rather than in the principal cortical/forebrain classes.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: The result turns a ubiquitous HOPS gene into a state- or cell-class-selective neuronal vulnerability in this dataset, and argues against averaging the perturbation across all brain excitatory neurons.

finding_summaries.summary: The two strongest glutamatergic signatures induced a lysosomal export/acidification module including Lamp2, Dpp7, Grn, Neu1, and Atp6v0b.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: A transporter known to export lysosomal sialic acid triggered increased lysosomal and V-ATPase-associated transcripts, consistent with an adaptive response to altered lysosomal membrane flux rather than a generic neuronal activation state.

finding_summaries.direction: largest positive lysosomal response in 151 and 155; sparse positive responses elsewhere
finding_summaries.summary: Rab7 perturbation generated a highly cell-type-skewed transcriptional response, dominated by 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: The effect of reducing a core late-endosomal GTPase is not uniform across mouse brain neuron classes; mechanisms inferred from the strongest cell types should not be projected onto every class.

finding_summaries.summary: Tsc1 perturbation induced a recurring lysosome/proteostasis plus sterol-biosynthesis module across the responsive neuronal classes.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: The repeated induction of Atp6v0b, Dpp7, Lamp2, Mcoln1, Cyp51, Dhcr7, Insig1, Ldlr, and related genes provides a compact transcriptomic readout of chronic TSC-mTORC1 pathway perturbation in neurons.

finding_summaries.direction: responsive in a restricted subset; weak or absent in most classes
finding_summaries.summary: Tsc2 perturbation produced a sharply cell-class-restricted RNA response, with most FDR-significant genes concentrated in five of 22 tested classes.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: TSC2 is a core mTOR suppressor, but the Perturb-seq output shows that this pathway was not uniformly coupled to a detectable transcriptional program across mouse-brain cell classes.

finding_summaries.summary: Ctsb diverged from upstream endolysosomal regulators Rab7 and Tsc1/Tsc2, which generated large Lamp2/Atp6v0b/Dpp7/Insig1-rich programs in the same library.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: The contrast argues that the Perturb-seq assay can detect lysosome-associated transcriptional remodeling, but loss of a terminal lysosomal protease did not phenocopy loss of trafficking or mTOR-regulatory nodes.

finding_summaries.summary: Slc17a5 perturbation produced a narrow, neuronal-subtype-restricted response: all FDR-significant genes were confined to 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA despite testing 23 cell types.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: Human and mouse loss-of-function biology establishes SLC17A5 as a CNS disease gene, but the Perturb-seq response separates a few vulnerable neuronal classes from many buffered classes.

finding_summaries.summary: Restricted-signature neighbors show that Slc17a5 resembles Vps41/Rab7/Tsc1/Tsc2/V-ATPase perturbations far more reproducibly than disease-family perturbations such as Gns, Lamp2, or Ppt1, and has reproducible anti-correlations with Uba5, Ufc1, and Ufsp2.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: This comparison narrows the Perturb-seq state from generic lysosomal storage to a lysosomal traffic, acidification, and nutrient-sensing axis, while flagging an unexplained negative relationship to the Uba5/Ufc1/Ufsp2 perturbations.

finding_summaries.direction: positive correlation to Rab7/Tsc1/Tsc2; weak to most other VPS-family targets
finding_summaries.summary: The Vps41 signature was closest to Rab7 and to Tsc1/Tsc2-Dctn1/Dync1h1/Slc17a5 neighbors, while retromer/GARP VPS-family perturbations were much weaker neighbors.
finding_summaries.why_it_matters: This preserves an informative cross-perturbation result: the dataset recovers the expected Rab7-HOPS axis but does not treat every VPS-family trafficking perturbation as interchangeable with Vps41.

resolved_evidence.statistics: Other lysosomal-disease perturbations were not consistent Slc17a5 mimics on the same 200-gene signatures: Gns correlations were -0.131 in 151, 0.322 in 155, and -0.029 in 191; Lamp2 correlations were 0.351, -0.126, and 0.027; Ppt1 correlations were 0.098, 0.206, and 0.059. In contrast, Vps41 reached r=0.528, 0.656, and 0.483, and Atp6v0a1 reached r=0.509 in 151 and r=0.407 in 155.

resolved_evidence.description: Transcriptome-wide signature-neighbor analysis linking Vps41 to Rab7, lysosomal nutrient sensing, and dynein-dynactin-adjacent perturbations.
resolved_evidence.statistics: Score-vector correlations among all perturbations in each cell type: in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Rab7 r=0.311 was the top non-self neighbor, Tsc1 r=0.217 ranked 2nd, Dctn1 r=0.214 ranked 3rd, and Tsc2 r=0.173 ranked 7th of 2045. In 155 MB Glut, Tsc1 r=0.257, Rab7 r=0.232, Tsc2 r=0.200, Slc17a5 r=0.191, and Vps37a r=0.161 ranked 1st-5th of 2040 non-self signatures. In 191 MB P MY GABA, Rab7 r=0.137, Dctn1 r=0.129, Tsc1 r=0.127, Tsc2 r=0.103, Dync1h1 r=0.100, and Slc17a5 r=0.099 ranked 1st-6th of 2018.

resolved_evidence.description: Availability and signature behavior of canonical HOPS and other VPS-family comparator perturbations.

title: Late endolysosomal and mTOR-regulatory losses induce a lysosomal-sterol module in TH and MB glutamatergic neurons
